description: This file defines data structures and functions related to displaying tool representations, including a summary struct 'ToolDisplaySummary', a registry 'ToolDisplayRegistry' responsible for loading configuration, resolving display info for tools, and functions for parsing and rendering tool details, with resource loading from a JSON configuration.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: A struct representing a summarized display of a tool with fields like name, emoji, title, label, verb, and detail.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: A singleton enum that manages loading of tool display configurations from a JSON resource, and resolving tool display summaries based on inputs.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a 'ToolDisplaySummary' for a given tool name, arguments, and optional meta field, using configuration and fallbacks.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration resource 'tool-display.json' from the bundle and decodes it into a 'ToolDisplayConfig'.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Returns a default configuration object if resource loading or decoding fails.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable title from a tool name by processing underscores and capitalization.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for read operations based on path, offset, and limit from the arguments.

methods.name: pathDetail
methods.description: Retrieves the 'path' detail from the args.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Returns the first successfully rendered string value from a list of keys in args.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a value (String, Int, Double, Bool, Array, Dict) into a string preview.

methods.name: valueForKeyPath
methods.description: Traverses nested dictionaries/arrays in 'args' to get a value for a dotted key path.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces the home directory path with '~' in a string.
